lesson_yaml:
schema: cairn/lesson/v0.1
id: java-nifi-scripting-component-missing-restricted-execute-code
title: NiFi controller service that compiles Groovy scripts lacks @Restricted(EXECUTE_CODE)
summary: A NiFi controller service evaluates user-configured Groovy through GroovyShell or GroovyClassLoader,
  but its class is not annotated with @Restricted and RequiredPermission.EXECUTE_CODE. Without it, any
  user allowed to configure components can make the NiFi JVM run arbitrary code, bypassing the restricted-component
  authorization that should gate that capability.
cwe:
- CWE-862
- CWE-94
severity: high
confidence: medium
languages:
- java
source:
  kind: fix-commit
  ref: 72fab7dde74edfd1063b57e87b0334340c1fbe93
  vulnerable_ref: 72fab7dde74edfd1063b57e87b0334340c1fbe93^
  patched_ref: 72fab7dde74edfd1063b57e87b0334340c1fbe93
  repository: https://github.com/apache/nifi
rule:
  message: 'Controller service $C evaluates Groovy code but is not annotated with

    @Restricted(restrictions = @Restriction(requiredPermission = RequiredPermission.EXECUTE_CODE, ...)).

    Users who can configure the component can execute arbitrary code without the restricted-component
    permission.

    '
  patterns:
  - pattern: "class $C extends AbstractControllerService {\n  ...\n  $R $M(...) {\n    ...\n    <... $SINK\
      \ ...>;\n    ...\n  }\n}\n"
  - metavariable-pattern:
      metavariable: $SINK
      pattern-either:
      - pattern: new GroovyShell(...)
      - pattern: new GroovyClassLoader(...)
  - pattern-not: "@Restricted(...)\nclass $C extends AbstractControllerService {\n  ...\n}\n"
fix:
  guidance: Annotate the component class with @Restricted and a @Restriction that requires RequiredPermission.EXECUTE_CODE,
    with an explanation, so only users granted the execute-code permission can configure it.
  example: "@Restricted(\n        restrictions = {\n                @Restriction(\n                  \
    \      requiredPermission = RequiredPermission.EXECUTE_CODE,\n                        explanation\
    \ = \"Enables configuration of scripted queries\"\n                )\n        }\n)\npublic class TinkerpopClientService\
    \ extends AbstractControllerService implements GraphClientService {\n    // ...\n}\n"

  patched:
